The '''Threshold of the Hidden Realms''',<ref name="CSWE Gates">{{CSWECite|I|327|Gates of Grontessiant}}</ref> also known as the '''Threshold to the Hidden Realms''', were a location in the mythology of the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The realms were accessible by the [[Gates of Grontessiant]], were inhabited by beings such as the [[Albino Cyclops]], the [[Swirblies]], the [[Lord Being of the Swirblies]], and the [[Four See Seers of the Cyclops]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Skakoan [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] entered the Threshold of the Hidden Realms and found the [[Eye of the Albino Cyclops]].<ref name="Wat Tambor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Threshold to the Hidden Realms first appeared in the comic story "[[Wat Tambor and the Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops]]," written and illustrated by [[Michael Murnane]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in the [[2005]] anthology ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]''.
